text:
Same ₹1 crore flat, three NCR cities, six different bills.

Stamp duty plus registration, man vs woman buyer:
Delhi: ₹7L vs ₹5L
Gurugram: ₹7.5L vs ₹5.5L
Noida: ₹8L vs ₹7L

Catch: the person named on the deed becomes the legal owner. Rates change, so check the state portal before you register.

Sources: NoBroker, HomeFirst, ClearTax, News On AIR. Education, not advice. #stampduty
